Every SOLUM is clad for the Australian climate, in fibre cement, steel or timber.

Urban Obsidian Ivory Forge Char Blackbutt

Each is chosen to sit quietly in its landscape, and finished to the same standard.

SOLUM Studio|External finishes

Choose your external finish:

Cladding

Settled on a cladding? Select it for your SOLUM Studio.

Urban Earth

Ivory board-formed concrete, walnut fins and soffits, and smoked olive satin metal for the walls. Warm and grounded, it sits as easily on a suburban street as in the bush, and the walnut glows when the lights come on at dusk.

Ivory board-formed concreteWalnut fins, smoked olive metal

Obsidian

Fibre cement in its darkest tone, behind bronze-tinted glass and black frames. The quietest of the claddings, it lets SOLUM recede into shadow and tree line.

Equitone fibre cementBronze-tinted, low-E glazing

Ivory

The same fibre cement in the pale of limestone, set against black frames. Ivory takes the first and last light of the day and holds on to it.

Equitone fibre cementBronze-tinted, low-E glazing

Forge

Black matt steel, run in long vertical seams. The most architectural of the claddings: sharp lines, deep shadow and no grain at all.

Snapseam steel wallingBlack matt finish

Char

Timber charred after the old practice of burning it to protect it, laid in a shiplap profile. A deep, warm black with the grain still showing through.

Charcoaled shiplap timberBAL 29 fire rated

Amber

Blackbutt, an Australian hardwood, laid in a shiplap profile. Amber carries the warmth of the timber to the outside of the house, and glows at dusk.

Blackbutt shiplapBAL 29 fire rated

Every cladding comes with double glazing, black matt metalwork and outdoor LED feature lighting.

Inspired by the Australian landscape, we’ve painstakingly designed five interior palettes.

Urban Burgundy Sage Tide Vine

Each is engineered as a complete composition, so every finish belongs and nothing is left to chance.

The way home

From the first conversation to the keys.

Every SOLUM is built the same way. How it reaches you depends on your site, and how much you’d like us to handle.

11 stages11 stages12 stages

  1. 01

    Initial enquiry

    It starts with a conversation about your site, plans or an idea.

  2. 02

    Assessment agreement

    A short agreement that lets us assess your site and brief properly.

  3. 03 In parallel

    Site assessment & selections

    We check your site while you choose cladding, palette and fittings.

  4. 04

    Itemised quote

    One itemised price, and the point where you choose how it arrives.

  5. 05 Optional

    Builder contract

    If you are engaging a builder, their contract sits alongside ours.

  6. 06

    Supply contract

    Scope, specification and price, fixed in writing before we build.

  7. 07

    Production deposit

    Secures your place in production and sets manufacture underway.

  8. 08

    Factory & shipping schedule

    Your production and shipping dates, booked for you to plan around.

  9. 09

    Built complete

    Built complete in our factory to the HAAVN BLACK standard.

  10. 10

    Collection at port

    The finished house ships to port for you or your builder to collect.

  11. 11

    Final payment

    Completes the supply, and the finished house is yours to collect.
